title: Owner-authorized first live daily trade-activity collection
objective: Apply the audited activity-metric migration, create or reuse only the required private Dune query registry entries, execute the aggregate-only core daily collection in dry-run delivery mode, and write a sanitized run report.
owner_authorization: Owner authorized Dune key use, writable local PostgreSQL, and daily aggregate reporting. The Owner-approved Feishu target remains available, but this task uses dry-run delivery only; no message is sent.
forbidden_actions: Do not print, store, commit, or expose Dune credentials, DATABASE_URL, Feishu IDs, tokens, cookies, raw Dune payloads, or full database records.
Do not send a Feishu message, invoke Hermes, or use --send.
Do not run raw Dune SQL, use a performance override, backfill history, activate BSC/Robinhood CA/RPC adapters, or alter project stage configuration.
Do not create duplicate saved queries: reuse an exact blueprint plus SQL hash match, update a prior blueprint query in place, and record only sanitized IDs and hashes.
Do not claim full BSC or Robinhood coverage, Four.meme, buy/sell, net liquidity, market-cap/FDV, Kline, cohort, recommendation, score, signing, or trading capability.
